title: 0284: CT-5 - the uniform S-diff gate is STRUCTURALLY DEAD (T4OffLS, green): impossible to close the face for all t >= tPT2; the 'needed future theorem' is provably non-existent
route: Route (b) - terminal reduction, gate mechanism audit
summary: CT-5 audits the last standing mechanism for a FACE-WIDE (uniform all t >= tPT2) exclusion via the 0276 gate: a per-piece S-difference bound c1(t), c2(t) <= cGate(t) with cGate a FIXED FINITE threshold (2.5821 at tPT2, decaying 1.3445 / 1.2578). The gate antecedent is IMPOSSIBLE, proven in three layers (formal module T4OffLS, strict rationals, two cited published axioms only, full tree 17,454 jobs 0 errors). LAYER L1 (measured, at EVERY t): the per-piece S-diff constant on the (gData, t-1] piece is c1 = Smax(t) + Smax(GLAST) (0274 g2 envelope, HSXW 2022 Cor. 1.4 form; 0276 published input 12.9117 = 6.862091 + 6.049376). Its FIXED part Smax(GLAST) = 6.049376 is the measured S-maximum level at the data cut, independent of t, and 6.049376 > 2.5847 = cGateN = max over all four sigmas - the strongest gate constant - at every profile point (the profile decays below it: 2.58 -> 1.34 -> 1.26). Violation 2.34x at tPT2, DIVERGING as t grows. CONSEQUENCE: the celebrated '5.00x miss' (0275-0278, 0280) was a misreading of where the obstruction sits - it is not an asymptotic O(ln t) constant gap to be sharpened; it is a STRUCTURAL violation: one fixed measured number alone exceeds the whole gate (and the published 12.9117 input exceeds 5x the tPT2 gate: 12.9117 > 5 x 2.5821, formal sdiffPubAbove5Gate). LAYER L2 (published, theorem): unconditionally, S(t) = Omega±((ln t / ln ln t)^(1/3)) (Ramachandra; standard Omega-lower bound, as recorded in Conrey's RH survey), so |S| is unbounded on every tail [t, infinity). With gData fixed, the piece S-diff |S(t-1) - S(gData)| >= |S(t-1)| - |S(gData)| is also unbounded in t: for EVERY C there is t >= tPT2 with |S(t-1) - S(gData)| >= C (formal pieceSdiffUnbounded). Any VALID per-piece S-diff bound c1(t) must be at least the actual diff, hence unbounded in t, while the gate threshold is fixed finite. Therefore the gate ANTECEDENT (for all t >= tPT2, c1(t) <= cGate(t)) is FALSE for every uniform finite threshold profile, for every S-stream (formal gateAntecedentFalse, via GateHolds). The 0276 gate is a one-way sufficient criterion (antecedent true => window empty), so it CANNOT close the face for all t >= tPT2: arbitrarily large t exist at which its hypothesis fails. This is a theorem ABOUT THE METHOD - it makes no statement about the face itself (the face may still be empty at those t by other means; the gate simply cannot certify it). LAYER L3 (corrigendum of the 0281/0282 CT framing): 'CT = a uniform all-t S-diff theorem below the first moment' does not exist - the statement is FALSE (unbounded S vs fixed/decaying finite threshold). It is NOT 'needed future mathematics of unknown existence'; it is provably non-existent. A face exclusion, IF TRUE, must come from a NON-gate mechanism (t-adaptive, or direct zero-count machinery from the 1e15 census and R-vM, or a different reduction). No such mechanism is available in present mathematics through 2026. THE S-ROUTE AVENUE IS TERMINALLY CLOSED THREE WAYS: measured (0283 realized wall, 1.087-1.722x at tPT2 typical face readings), statistical (0278/0281 first-moment wall, 1.596/3.882/5.032 growing), structural (THIS unit, T4OffLS: antecedent false for all t by the published unboundedness of S + the fixed 6.049376 level). Axioms cited in T4OffLS: SUnbounded (consequence of S = Omega±((ln t/ln ln t)^(1/3)), Ramachandra, unconditional) and SGdataBounded (|S(gData)| <= SmaxGLAST = 6.049376, 0276 published input, measured). Face OPEN. No zero-free claim. NO RH CLAIM. Formal T4OffLS theorems: smaxExceedsGateN, smaxExceedsGateAll, sdiffPubAbove5Gate, pieceSdiffUnbounded, GateHolds, gateAntecedentFalse, profileDecays, ct5GateDeath (composite: L1-envelope + 5x-published + antecedent-false + profile-decay).
